text_ref.volume_en: Shan Hai Jing · Nan Shan Jing
text_ref.passage: 又東三百里，曰青丘之山。其陽多玉，其陰多青䨼。有獸焉，其狀如狐而九尾，其音如嬰兒，能食人。食者不蠱。

entries.prompt: The nine-tailed fox of Chinese mythology, standing on a rocky outcrop and looking back over its shoulder. Its nine long tails spread out behind it, thick and full of fur. Painted in the manner of a traditional Chinese album leaf, fine ink brushwork, delicate fur strokes, ink and pale colour on aged paper.
